name: Long Hike with a Cute Girl
source:
Grace asked you to come with her on a quiet early morning hike, but her tight shorts and upbeat attitude make it seem like maybe she has a little more in store for you...

[from [url=https://cozykeeper.itch.io/long-hike-with-a-cute-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Grace约你在宁静的清晨一同徒步。不过，她的紧身短裤与热情开朗的态度，似乎暗示着，她还为你准备了别的惊喜……

[摘自[url=https://cozykeeper.itch.io/long-hike-with-a-cute-girl]itch.io[/url]]
